notes: measures.frame remains the historical interval between renderer.draw entries; drawSubmission is its explicit alias. This is neither the rAF callback cadence nor presentation timing.

raf uses game.samples (browser-supplied rAF timestamps); observedRaf contains only callbacks that submitted a measured frame. game.samples may include a boundary frame while GPU profiling starts or drains.

preRenderCpu/renderCpu/postRenderCpu are elapsed main-thread intervals within the same game rAF callback; system interruptions may be included. Fixed mode runs two simulation ticks after renderer.draw, while realtime runs them before it.
lastCompletedGpuMs is the latest asynchronously completed GPU timestamp sample, not a timestamp associated with this row. It excludes queue wait and presentation.
Both regular rAF timestamps and regular CPU submissions can coexist with irregular GPU presentation. These metrics do not claim presentation cadence.
Rows are numeric preallocated storage during measurement; row objects, summaries and slow-frame neighbourhoods are constructed only after measurement stops.

clockAlignment.note: callbackDelay = performance.now() at callback entry minus browser rAF timestamp. Signed offsets down to -1 ms are retained as clock alignment/precision effects; larger negative offsets fail validation. No positive delay is clipped.

protocol: 960 pedestrians, same legal quay placement and civilian/police traffic as outdoor stress. Three actual vehicle detonations in one simulation tick at frame90; real Marseille facade blasts power240/radius10 at frames210/330, revealing physical furnishing. Fixed camera. Two 1/120 simulation ticks per rendered frame. Graphics unchanged; simulation/debris and render counts sampled every60frames. Historical frame measures renderer.draw submission intervals; raf reports browser rAF timestamps separately. Neither measures actual presentation.

timingDefinitions.frame: Legacy alias of drawSubmission, retained for baseline compatibility.
timingDefinitions.drawSubmission: Interval between CPU entries to renderer.draw, after simulation and model generation in realtime mode.
timingDefinitions.raf: Delta between browser-supplied rAF timestamps from game.samples; may include boundary callbacks while GPU profiling starts/drains.
timingDefinitions.gpu: GPU elapsed passes only; excludes queue wait, CPU uploads before submit, compositor and presentation.
timingDefinitions.presentation: Not measured. Regular rAF timestamps do not prove regular GPU presentation.
